steps.en: Install the native bundle and start it on loopback
steps.zh: 安装原生包，并绑定回环地址启动

steps.en: Add a repository; choose an agent profile, Worktree executor and bounded task
steps.zh: 添加仓库，选择助手、工作树执行器和有界任务

steps.en: Prepare a separate checkout and start the selected agent
steps.zh: 准备独立检出目录，启动所选助手

steps.en: Collect the conversation and Git changes in the task workbench
steps.zh: 在任务工作台汇总对话和 Git 改动

steps.en: Review the patch and tests before advancing the human-gated step
steps.zh: 检查补丁与测试，再推进人工关口

steps.en: Keep task progress and review context together for the next handoff
steps.zh: 把任务进度和评审上下文留在同一处

value.en: Parallel coding work reaches one review surface instead of scattered terminal tabs
value.zh: 并行编程工作汇入同一评审界面，不再散落终端标签页
